title: Baicalin Mitigates the Neuroinflammation through the TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB and MAPK Pathways in LPS-Stimulated BV-2 Microglia.
authors: Li, Baojing; Wang, Mingming; Chen, Shuai; Li, Manping; Zeng, Jing; Wu, Saichun; Tu, Yuanqing; Li, Yanping; Zhang, Rongping; Huang, Feng; Tong, Xiaoyun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄酮化合物Baicalin通过TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB和MAPK通路缓解LPS诱导的神经炎症，仅含少量分子对接（蛋白-小分子），无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Baicalin (BA) is a major flavone from Scutellaria baicalensis Georgi and has showed significant curative effects in Parkinson's and Alzheimer's diseases. In the present study, we investigated the effects of BA on antineuroinflammation and related signaling cascade in lipopolysaccharide- (LPS-) induced BV-2 microglial model. The results showed that BA significantly attenuated inflammatory mediators (NO, iNOS, IL-1beta, COX-2, and PGE2) and suppressed the expression of miR-155. More crucially, BA could regulate the expression of related proteins in Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4)/myeloid differentiation protein 88 (MyD88)/nuclear factor kappaB (NF-kappaB) pathway and suppress the phosphorylation of mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK) family. In addition, molecular docking analysis indicated that BA binds to the amino acids Lie 63 and Tyr 65 of TLR4 by pi-sigma and pi-pi T-shaped interaction. Thus, BA suppressed the LPS-stimulated neuroinflammation in BV-2 microglia by blocking the TLR4-mediated signal transduction through TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB and MAPK pathways and inhibiting the miR-155 expression. Our findings demonstrated that BA could be a valuable therapeutic for the treatment of neuroinflammation and neurodegenerative diseases.
abstract_zh: 黄芩苷（BA）是黄芩（Scutellaria baicalensis Georgi）中的一种主要黄酮类化合物，在帕金森病和阿尔茨海默病中显示出显著的疗效。在本研究中，我们探讨了BA在脂多糖（LPS）诱导的BV-2小胶质细胞模型中对抗神经炎症及其相关信号级联反应的影响。结果表明，BA显著减轻了炎症介质（NO、iNOS、IL-1β、COX-2和PGE2）并抑制了miR-155的表达。更为关键的是，BA能够调节Toll样受体4（TLR4）/髓样分化蛋白88（MyD88）/核因子κB（NF-κB）通路中相关蛋白的表达，并抑制丝裂原活化蛋白激酶（MAPK）家族的磷酸化。此外，分子对接分析表明，BA通过π-σ和π-π T形相互作用与TLR4的氨基酸残基Ile 63和Tyr 65结合。因此，BA通过阻断TLR4介导的信号转导（涉及TLR4/MyD88/NF-κB和MAPK通路）并抑制miR-155的表达，从而抑制了LPS刺激的BV-2小胶质细胞中的神经炎症。我们的发现表明，BA可能成为治疗神经炎症和神经退行性疾病的有价值治疗药物。
